sentences.en: Following the riots, incidents of looting in affluent neighborhoods multiplied.
sentences.zh: 骚乱之后，在富裕社区发生的抢劫事件增加了。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to multiply its economy in the next decade.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要在未来十年里扩大其经济规模。

sentences.en: They're multiplying faster than we can kill them off.
sentences.zh: 它们繁殖的速度比我们消灭它们还快。

senses.zh: 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘
